headlines.title: 深圳市房地产中介协会：8月深圳二手住宅录得5108套 同比增长7.6%

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association: August Second-Hand Residential Transactions Recorded at 5,108 Units, Up 7.6% Year-on-Year
headlines.summary_en: According to statistics from the Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association, second-hand housing transactions in August 2026 totaled 5,535 units, down 3.3% month-on-month and up 5.1% year-on-year; second-hand residential transactions reached 5,108 units, down 2.3% month-on-month and up 7.6% year-on-year. Although August volumes continued to edge lower from July, the year-on-year growth rate expanded further from the previous month, indicating that while recent momentum has cooled somewhat, overall volumes remain clearly above year-ago levels and the market remains stable. (Securities Times)

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen New Commercial Housing Sales Reach 3,467 Units in August
headlines.summary_en: According to the latest data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association, new commercial housing transactions in Shenzhen totaled 3,467 units in August, down 23.0% month-on-month but up 4.8% year-on-year. Second-hand residential properties recorded 5,108 transactions, down 2.3% month-on-month and up 7.6% year-on-year. From January to August, cumulative second-hand housing transactions in Shenzhen reached approximately 48,400 units, up 4.7% year-on-year.

headlines.summary:
Taiwan’s cabinet approved a supplementary defence budget of NT$145.7 billion (US$4.6 billion) on Thursday, pushing the island’s total defence-related spending for this year above NT$1 trillion for the first time.
The additional funding is expected to raise this year’s overall defence spending from 3.32 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) to about 3.83 per cent, the highest level in decades.

headlines.title_en: Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum Held in Shenzhen; Li Shulei Attends Opening Ceremony and Delivers Keynote Speech
headlines.summary_en: The Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum opened in Shenzhen, Guangdong on September 5. Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a keynote speech. Huang Kunming, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Guangdong Province, attended and delivered remarks. Participants noted that President Xi Jinping's major proposal on building an Asia-Pacific community provides important guidance for jointly fostering an open Asia-Pacific economy and promoting common prosperity. This year is the 'China Year' for APEC, and China will host the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting. It is believed that with support from all parties, the meeting will yield fruitful results and elevate Asia-Pacific cooperation to new heights. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 多国推进黄金储备本土化布局
headlines.summary: 全球多国都在加快调整黄金储备存放布局，降低对欧美单一托管体系的依赖。自2013年起，多国陆续启动海外黄金储备回迁。世界黄金协会2026年央行黄金储备调查显示，过去12个月里，19%的央行提高了国内黄金储备比例，或者把储备地点做了多元化配置，一年前这个比例只有7%，寄存于纽约、伦敦金库的央行数量持续减少。（CCTV国际时讯）

headlines.title_en: Multiple Countries Advance Localization of Gold Reserve Holdings
headlines.summary_en: Multiple countries are accelerating adjustments to their gold reserve storage arrangements, reducing reliance on the single custodian system in the U.S. and Europe. Since 2013, several countries have successively initiated repatriation of overseas gold reserves. The World Gold Council's 2026 central bank gold reserve survey shows that over the past 12 months, 19% of central banks increased their domestic gold reserve share or diversified storage locations, up from just 7% a year earlier. The number of central banks storing gold in New York and London vaults continues to decline. (CCTV Global Business)

headlines.title: 中国奢侈品消费复苏再现“昙花一现”？伯恩斯坦发出警告
headlines.summary: 伯恩斯坦分析师指出，第三季度初期数据显示中国奢侈品消费明显放缓，令该板块的复苏再度面临“昙花一现”的风险。来自奢侈品购物中心的销售数据显示，6月及7月各价位及品类的消费均大幅走弱，7月份更录得同比下滑12%。今年第一季度整体增长基本持平，第二季度则仅录得低个位数增长。 此次放缓打断了过去四个季度逐步复苏的态势。分析指，消费者信心在疫情后持续低迷，加之奢侈品牌在疫后消费热潮期间大幅提价，令中产阶层购买力承压；当局加强对境外资产的审查，以及更严格税务执法的预期，似乎正在抑制高净值人士的消费意愿。 受上述趋势走弱影响，第三季度行业有机增长预测被下调110个基点

headlines.title_en: China's Luxury Consumption Recovery Shows 'Flash in the Pan' Again? Bernstein Issues Warning
headlines.summary_en: Bernstein analysts noted that early third-quarter data shows a significant slowdown in Chinese luxury consumption, putting the sector's recovery at renewed risk of being 'short-lived.' Sales data from luxury shopping malls show consumption weakened substantially across price points and categories in June and July, with July recording a 12% year-on-year decline. Overall growth in the first quarter was roughly flat, while the second quarter saw only low single-digit growth. This slowdown interrupts the gradual recovery seen over the past four quarters. Analysts said consumer confidence has remained weak since the pandemic, and hefty price increases by luxury brands during the post-pandemic spending boom have squeezed middle-class purchasing power; authorities' heightened scrutiny of overseas assets and expectations of stricter tax enforcement appear to be curbing high-net-worth individuals' spending intentions. Due to these weakening trends, third-quarter industry organic growth forecasts were cut by 110 basis points.

headlines.title: As hordes head to Shenzhen, Hong Kong bars, restaurants sign up for more floor space
headlines.summary:
Hong Kong’s food and beverage (F&B) operators, both new and existing players, signed leases for 155,000 sq ft of new floor space in the second quarter of this year, a record high for the sector and more than double the amount registered in the first quarter, according to property consultancy CBRE.

headlines.title_zh: 随着大批人群涌向深圳，香港酒吧和餐厅纷纷租用更多楼面空间
headlines.summary_zh: 据房地产咨询公司世邦魏理仕（CBRE）数据，香港餐饮业（F&B）运营商（包括新老业者）在今年第二季度签署了15.5万平方英尺的新增楼面租约，创下该行业纪录，是第一季度的两倍多。上半年，他们共租下23万平方英尺。

headlines.title: 脑机接口企业术理创新启动IPO辅导
headlines.summary: 记者从术理创新（上海）智能科技股份有限公司（以下简称“术理创新”)获悉，9月4日，术理创新正式启动科创板上市辅导。证监会官网IPO辅导公示系统显示，术理创新于2026年9月4日在上海证监局办理辅导备案登记，正式启动科创板IPO进程，华泰联合证券担任术理创新本次上市的辅导机构。资料显示，术理创新2015年成立，注册地为上海奉贤。公司以非侵入式路线为主，核心产品聚焦中枢神经损伤导致肢体运动障碍，意识与认知障碍，和神经发育障碍等市场痛点。在2026世界人工智能大会期间，术理创新展出的核心产品包括脑机接口运动神经功能重塑产品套装、脑机接口电刺激治疗仪、脑机接口数

headlines.title_en: Brain-Computer Interface Firm Shul Innovation Launches IPO Tutoring
headlines.summary_en: According to information from Shuli Innovation (Shanghai) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter 'Shuli Innovation'), the company officially initiated its STAR Market listing guidance on September 4. The CSRC IPO guidance disclosure system shows that Shuli Innovation filed guidance registration with the Shanghai Securities Regulatory Bureau on September 4, 2026, formally commencing its STAR Market IPO process, with Huatai United Securities serving as the guidance institution. Company data shows Shuli Innovation was established in 2015 and registered in Fengxian, Shanghai. The company focuses on non-invasive approaches, with core products targeting market pain points including limb motor dysfunction caused by central nervous system injury, disorders of consciousness and cognition, and neurodevelopmental disorders. At the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference, Shuli Innovation's featured products included brain-computer interface motor function reconstruction product suites, brain-computer interface electrical stimulation therapy devices, and brain-computer interface data-related products.

headlines.title: 中美据报拟于9月中旬举行AI安全会谈
headlines.summary: 据路透，中美正加紧筹备9月中旬举行的会谈，探讨AI安全风险。消息人士透露，美方希望讨论如何合作监测AI驱动的网络攻击。有倡议要求中美AI实验室“自我监管”并共享信息，以防止与AI有关的网络攻击。 此次会谈是自美国总统特朗普去年重返白宫以来，中美首次就AI问题举行正式双边会谈。听取相关筹备简报的知情人士说，美方代表团将由美国财政部长贝森特率领。中方代表团可能由国务院副总理何立峰率领。不过，中方也在考虑其他人选，包括副总理丁薛祥。报道称，美国财政部发言人表示，目前尚未规划任何会议。

headlines.title_en: US and China Reportedly Plan Mid-September AI Security Talks
headlines.summary_en: According to Reuters, China and the U.S. are intensifying preparations for talks in mid-September to discuss AI security risks. Sources said Washington hopes to discuss how to cooperate on monitoring AI-driven cyberattacks. There are initiatives calling for 'self-regulation' and information sharing between Chinese and American AI labs to prevent AI-related cyberattacks. The talks would mark the first formal bilateral meeting between China and the U.S. on AI since President Trump returned to the White House last year. Sources briefed on the preparations said the U.S. delegation would be led by Treasury Secretary Bessent, while the Chinese delegation may be led by Vice Premier He Lifeng, though other candidates including Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang are also being considered. A U.S. Treasury spokesperson said no meeting has been planned at this time.

headlines.title: 华为何庭波更新韬定律论文
headlines.summary: 堆叠更多晶体管，芯片反而更冷——这一看似反直觉的结论，成为华为半导体负责人何庭波最新论文试图回答的核心问题。9月4日，何庭波在中科院科技论文预发布平台ChinaXiv发布论文《Huawei’s τ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?》（《华为的τ芯片本该过热烧毁？》），通过麒麟2026的实测数据，回应业界对3D堆叠芯片“高密度带来高功耗、高发热”的质疑。

headlines.title_en: Huawei's He Tingbo Updates Tao Ding Paper
headlines.summary_en: Stacking more transistors while the chip runs cooler—this seemingly counterintuitive conclusion is the core question addressed in the latest paper by He Tingbo, head of Huawei's semiconductor division. On September 4, He Tingbo published a paper titled 'Huawei's τ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?' on ChinaXiv, the Chinese Academy of Sciences' preprint platform, using measured data from the Kirin 2026 to respond to industry skepticism about 3D-stacked chips' 'high density bringing high power consumption and high heat.'

headlines.title: 国开行簿记发行50亿元绿色金融债券
headlines.summary: 国家开发银行日前在上海清算所成功簿记发行50亿元3年期绿色金融债券，发行利率1.27%。据介绍，这是国开行首次采用线上簿记建档方式发行绿色金融债券，有效提升了发行效率和透明度。本次发行是国开行优化债券发行定价机制、缩小一二级市场价差的新尝试，也是以市场化方式赋能绿色低碳融资的新探索。本次发行的债券所募集资金将主要用于基础设施绿色升级、节能降碳产业、能源绿色低碳转型、生态保护修复和利用等重点领域。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: CDB Book-Runs Issuance of 5 Billion Yuan Green Financial Bonds
headlines.summary_en: The China Development Bank (CDB) recently completed bookbuilding issuance of 5 billion yuan in 3-year green financial bonds at the Shanghai Clearing House, with an issuance rate of 1.27%. This marks CDB's first green financial bond issuance using online bookbuilding and filing, effectively improving issuance efficiency and transparency. The issuance represents a new attempt by CDB to optimize bond issuance pricing mechanisms and narrow primary-secondary market spreads, as well as a new exploration of empowering green and low-carbon financing through market-based methods. Proceeds from the bonds will mainly fund key areas including green infrastructure upgrades, energy conservation and carbon reduction industries, green and low-carbon energy transition, and ecological protection and restoration. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 两年期美债收益率于非农日涨超2.9个基点，同期实际收益率本周累跌将近9.1个基点
headlines.summary: 周五（9月4日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨1.41个基点，报4.7821%，北京时间20:28（美国非农就业报告出炉前两分钟）跌至4.7440%刷新日低、数据发布时拉升至4.8103%刷新日高，本周累计上涨6.41个基点，主要交投于4.78%附近。 两年期美债收益率涨2.92个基点，报4.3661%，非农报告出炉时从日低4.3265%附近拉升至4.4163%刷新日高，本周累涨2.27个基点，整体呈现出N形走势。

headlines.title_en: Two-year U.S. Treasury yields rose over 2.9 basis points on nonfarm payrolls day, with real yields for the same period down nearly 9.1 basis points for the week.
headlines.summary_en: In New York late trading Friday (September 4), the U.S. 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 1.41 basis points to 4.7821%, falling to a daily low of 4.7440% at 20:28 Beijing time (two minutes before the nonfarm payrolls release), then surging to a daily high of 4.8103% upon data release, accumulating a weekly gain of 6.41 basis points with trading mainly around 4.78%. The 2-year Treasury yield rose 2.92 basis points to 4.3661%, jumping from near its daily low of 4.3265% to a daily high of 4.4163% at the payrolls release, with a weekly gain of 2.27 basis points, showing an overall N-shaped trajectory.

headlines.title: 韩国出口额突破全年纪录，今年迄今达7094亿美元
headlines.summary: 韩国海关周六表示，今年迄今韩国出口额已达7094亿美元，超过了去年的全年纪录，这得益于全球对人工智能芯片需求的激增，推动韩国经济持续向好。该国去年的出口额为7093亿美元，连续第二年创下年度纪录。韩国海关总署称，作为亚洲第四大经济体，韩国今年有望实现年度出口额1万亿美元，成为继美国、中国和德国之后第四个达到这一里程碑的国家。韩国8月份出口额同比激增69%，连续第15个月保持增长势头。

headlines.title_en: South Korea's Exports Break Annual Record, Reaching $709.4 Billion So Far This Year
headlines.summary_en: Korea Customs said Saturday that the country's exports have reached $709.4 billion so far this year, surpassing last year's full-year record, driven by surging global demand for AI chips that continues to bolster Korea's economy. Last year's exports totaled $709.3 billion, setting an annual record for the second consecutive year. Korea Customs said the Asian fourth-largest economy is on track to achieve annual exports of $1 trillion this year, becoming the fourth country after the U.S., China, and Germany to reach that milestone. Korean exports in August surged 69% year-on-year, marking the 15th consecutive month of growth.
